blurb: Lake Effects Boat Rentals offers premium boat rentals at Stutts Marina and Midway Marina on Lake Norman. They provide a variety of boats including luxury pontoons, tritoons, ski boats, wakesurf boats, and jet skis. Rentals include well-maintained boats with upgraded features and easy check-in processes at convenient lake locations.
